messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Yes, I can help with a return of the delivered order—but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Also, to confirm the items and calculate the refund, please share your **order ID** (it looks like `#W0000000`).
Sure! My name is Yusuf Gonzalez and my zip code is 91455. I don’t remember my email address, but I can provide my order ID if needed.
yusuf_gonzalez_8900

Thanks, Yusuf—I've found your account: **yusuf_gonzalez_8900**.

2) The **payment method** you want the refund to go to (e.g., original card or a gift card)

Once you provide the order ID, I’ll look up the delivered items and tell you **the exact refund amount**.
